releases.title: SHADOW MODEL 1.0.0 — first verified release
releases.notes:
Initial verified public release of the SHADOW MODEL Windows desktop application.

Native SHADOW MODEL is available as a first-class, independently trained model with its own byte-level BPE tokenizer, decoder-only Transformer, checkpoint system and streaming CPU inference.
AI chat workspace with streaming replies, Markdown/code rendering, file attachments and persistent conversation history.
Voice assistant with whisper.cpp speech-to-text, wake-word detection and Windows SAPI narration.
Image attachments with vision-capable provider support and OCR text extraction for local models.
Document reading for PDF, DOCX, XLSX, TXT, CSV and JSON attachments.
Arabic and English interface with UTF-8-safe tokenisation.
Bundled Qt 6, Visual C++ x64 runtime, llama.cpp and whisper.cpp engines, plus the licensed Qwen2.5 1.5B Q4_K_M and Whisper Base models.
Application smoke test passed against the packaged build before release.
releases.requirements:
Windows 10 64-bit (version 1903 or newer) or Windows 11.
4 CPU cores (tested target: Intel Core i5-2500).
8 GB free RAM; 16 GB recommended for larger models.
About 1.5 GB free disk space for the installed application, engines and bundled models.
No GPU required; inference and training run on the CPU.
The Qt 6 and Visual C++ 2015-2022 x64 runtimes are bundled in the installer.
Arabic narration requires an Arabic SAPI voice installed in Windows.

site_content.hero_description: SHADOW MODEL is a private, Windows desktop AI assistant built for chat, voice, images and documents — with Arabic and English support.
site_content.app_description: A focused desktop experience that keeps your conversations, files and models close at hand. No browser tab required.

features.title: AI Chat
features.description: A native Qt chat workspace with streaming replies, Markdown and code rendering, file attachments and saved conversation history.

features.title: Independent SHADOW Model
features.description: A first-class, independently trained byte-level BPE Transformer with its own tokenizer, checkpoints, training controls and streaming CPU inference.
features.note: Experimental and CPU-first. It is not equivalent to a large cloud model and must be trained before use.

features.title: Voice Assistant
features.description: Microphone input with whisper.cpp transcription, wake-word detection and offline narration through Windows SAPI voices.
features.note: Arabic narration requires an Arabic SAPI voice installed in Windows.

features.title: Image Understanding
features.description: Attach images to a conversation and query vision-capable providers, with OCR text extraction available to local models.
features.note: Native SHADOW receives OCR text only. Scene understanding requires a configured vision-capable provider.

features.title: Document Reading
features.description: Read and query PDF, DOCX, XLSX, TXT, CSV and JSON attachments directly inside the chat workspace.
features.note: PDF support covers selectable text; scanned PDFs need OCR. Office extraction is a minimal built-in reader.

features.title: Conversation Memory
features.description: Persistent conversation history plus a separate conversation-memory store that keeps context across turns.
features.note: Training data is never collected from conversations.

features.title: Arabic and English
features.description: A bilingual interface with Arabic and English themes, RTL support and lossless UTF-8 handling in the tokenizer.

features.title: Windows Desktop Application
features.description: A native C++17 / Qt 6 x64 application with bundled Qt and VC++ runtimes, local engines and an optional portable model set.
features.note: No browser is required for local features.

system_requirements.label: Graphics
system_requirements.value: Not required; the CPU build runs on integrated graphics

system_requirements.label: Disk space
system_requirements.value: About 1.5 GB for the app, engines and both models

system_requirements.label: Additional runtime
system_requirements.value: Qt 6 and Visual C++ x64 runtimes are bundled in the official installer

install_steps: Download the installer for the latest verified release from the Download page.
Compare the downloaded file's SHA-256 with the checksum shown on the release card.
Run the installer and choose an installation folder, or use the portable folder if supplied.
Launch SHADOW MODEL from the Start Menu or from ShadowAI.exe.
Open Settings → Local AI and select the bundled models, or download models from the Settings page.

faq.q: Is this the official download site?
faq.a: Yes. SHADOW DOWNLOAD is the dedicated distribution site for the SHADOW MODEL Windows desktop application. It is separate from the AI chat website.

faq.q: Is there a verified release available?
faq.a: Only releases that have been built, checksummed and verified are published here. If the Download page says no release is available, do not trust installers from other sources.

faq.q: How do I verify the installer?
faq.a: Open PowerShell in the download folder and run: Get-FileHash .\<installer-name> -Algorithm SHA256. Compare the result with the checksum published on the Download page.

faq.q: Does SHADOW MODEL need an internet connection?
faq.a: Local chat, voice transcription, document reading and the native SHADOW model work offline. Cloud providers and model downloads require internet access and your own credentials.
Windows 10 64-bit (1903+) and Windows 11. The supported range for each build is listed on its release card.

faq.q: Where can I report a problem?
faq.a: Use the official support link in the footer. Include your Windows version, the release version and the SHA-256 of the file you downloaded.
